item.name: 9. Rate limit (run separately)
item.description: Restart the API first (docker compose restart api) to reset the counters. Then open the Runner, select only this folder and run it with more iterations than the auth limit (e.g. 22 for a limit of 20). The first requests return 401, the rest 429. This locks login for 15 minutes; restart the API to unlock.
